fee_notes: Uniform $50,000 fee, non-refundable. Multi-unit development fee is $50,000 for first restaurant plus $25,000 per additional; minimum 3-unit commitment. Development fee credits apply toward franchise fees.
raw_excerpt: When you sign the franchise agreement you will pay us a $50,000 initial franchise fee. The initial franchise fee is uniform for all franchisees, and is non-refundable upon payment.
